harness: probe service (tools/stallfloor/probe.py): frozen kernel families, every thread of every launch judged against a host-computed checksum
what: the in-order cover of a BARE shared-memory load by a YOUNGER load of the same pipe (kind ord, the cover set of probe.py 30): the bare load has NO write barrier and its register holds a marker until the load lands; the younger load (the cover) carries the write barrier; the reader of the bare load's register stands behind ONE wait on that barrier - on the reader itself, or on a `MOV` of the cover's register in front of it; each request with its positive control (the reader instructions at the same place with NO wait in front of them, the `MOV` with the wait behind them). Four groups: (1) fz* - a bare `LDS` (read as a block scale by `@P2 QMMA.SF` and by an unguarded `MOV`), a bare `LDS.64` and a bare `@P2 LDS.128` (read by `MOV`), each under a younger `@P0 LDS.128` whose guard is false (_f), true (_t) or a bit of the iteration counter (_c); the reader 2 cycles behind the cover, the bare load 1, 4 and 35 | 32 | 13 cycles in front of the cover; _f_v: the wait on a `MOV` of the cover's register, 35 + 31 + 10 | 32 + 71 + 98 | 13 + 71 + 4 cycles (bare -> cover -> wait -> reader), as a vendor's schedule places such a read; six grids. (2) po_* - a bare `LDS` | `LDS.64` under an unguarded `LDS` | `LDS.64` | a `@P0 LDS.128` with a true guard, the bare load 3 ... 66 cycles in front of the reader; 1 and 12 warps per SM. (3) bc_* - the loads read two regions behind the threads' lines: a slow one (one record per lane 128 B apart: the 32 lanes of a warp on ONE bank at different words) and a fast one (a lane a bank): _b the bare load slow and the cover fast, _c the reverse, _n both fast; 1 and 12 warps per SM. (4) nl2_* - a scale set of two `LDS` with NO load at all (a filler in the place of every load, the scale registers hold the unit scale): the guards of its two tensor instructions two bits of the lane (ll), one of them (lt, tl), uniform (tt) - under a guard that differs between the lanes of one warp a tensor instruction departs from the lane-by-lane host model; not a measurement of a barrier - on a Workstation Edition card, beside a sustained load at the 400-W limit

conditions.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition
conditions.load: the shipped attention kernel sparse_mla_prefill_v41 (sha256 c896234b...) in its timing loop, a second process on the same card

classes.overtake: war: the read-back saw the slot before the store in all 256
